title: layr attestations <rev> --json
description: The signed attestations (evidence) of one state or view, in the order they were recorded. With --kind <kind>, only attestations of that kind. A revoked attestation stays in the list; its revoke is an attestation of kind 'revoke'.

id.description: A layr id in UUID form.

format.description: The format version of the attestation record.

attestation_id.description: The id of the attestation. The revision 'attestations/<id>' resolves to its subject.

id.description: The id of the state, or the id of the view.

change_id.description: The id of the change of the subject state. Absent when it has none.

payload_digest.description: The SHA-256 digest of the payload, as 64 lowercase hex digits.

payload_ref.description: Where the payload is kept, when it is kept apart from the record.

signer.description: Who signed the record: the id of a machine, or 'person:<login>' for a person key ('layr request').

time.description: When the attestation was recorded, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
